## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and 5/5 neighbors concur [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%; others <1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | Normal only (90%) | Unambiguous |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 66th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same class | Concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal [F5] | Full agreement |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 1, 4, 7) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (regions 2, 3, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; linked to lower invasion · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; no invasion signal · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; favors non-invasive tissue · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 10) · ↑ invasive · Slightly above typical; negligible contribution · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions beats random (+0.54 logit drop, CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002, −0.005 to 0.007); not shown faithful. Normal lobules (0/20) Unreliable; lymphocytes (8/20) Weak.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) shifts scores; reliability only modestly flags errors (AUROC 0.69).
- Small test set (132); the 90% conformal guarantee is dataset-level, not per-case.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 8**: confirm two-layered lobular epithelium; concept failed spot check (0/20).
2. **Regions 4, 10**: assess nuclear pleomorphism, slightly above typical here.
3. **Region 7**: look for intraductal atypia (concept weak, 12/20).
